stories.title: Implement user authentication with OAuth 2.0
stories.description: As a user, I want to securely log in using OAuth 2.0 so that my credentials are protected. This includes integration with Google, Microsoft, and GitHub providers. Need to implement token refresh mechanism and handle edge cases for expired sessions.

stories.title: Fix button alignment on mobile devices
stories.description: The submit button on the login page is misaligned on mobile devices with screen width less than 375px. Need to adjust CSS media queries.

stories.title: Migrate database from MySQL to PostgreSQL
stories.description: As part of our infrastructure modernization, we need to migrate our entire database from MySQL 5.7 to PostgreSQL 14. This includes schema migration, data migration, updating all queries, and ensuring zero downtime during the migration process.

stories.title: Add dark mode toggle to user settings
stories.description: Users want the ability to switch between light and dark themes. Implement a toggle in user settings that persists the preference and applies it across all pages.

stories.title: Implement real-time notifications using WebSockets
stories.description: As a user, I want to receive real-time notifications for important events without refreshing the page. This requires implementing WebSocket connections, handling reconnection logic, and creating a notification center UI component.

stories.title: Optimize API response time for dashboard queries
stories.description: Dashboard API endpoints are taking 3-5 seconds to respond. Need to implement caching, optimize database queries, and add pagination to improve performance to under 500ms.

stories.title: Create user onboarding tutorial
stories.description: New users are confused about how to use the platform. Create an interactive tutorial that guides them through key features on first login.

stories.title: Fix memory leak in data processing module
stories.description: The data processing module is causing memory leaks when processing large datasets (>10MB). Memory usage grows continuously and doesn't get garbage collected. Need to investigate and fix.

stories.title: Add export to PDF functionality for reports
stories.description: Users want to export their reports as PDF files. Implement PDF generation with proper formatting, charts, and tables.

stories.title: Implement two-factor authentication (2FA)
stories.description: As a security enhancement, implement two-factor authentication using TOTP (Time-based One-Time Password). Support authenticator apps like Google Authenticator and Authy.
